name: Ingreso como Turista (Visa-Exempt / Tourist Entry)

requirements.blocker_text: Nationals of a broad list of American, European, and Asia-Pacific countries (e.g. most of the Americas, EU/EEA, UK, Japan, South Korea, Australia) may enter visa-free. Most other nationalities (much of Africa, the Middle East, parts of Asia) require prior authorisation ('autorización previa') before travel.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for prior authorization if not visa-exempt.

outcome.duration_length: 90 days (30 days for Malaysian nationals under a special arrangement)

sources.title: Ministerio del Interior de Uruguay -- Régimen de visas de admisión: visa-exempt nationality list, 90-day standard stay

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Uruguay's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1, including the full visa-exempt nationality list and the 90-day standard admission period. Employment purposes or stays beyond 90 days require prior consultation with authorities even for otherwise visa-exempt nationals -- this route covers ordinary tourism only.
